segments.name: Animal Health
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets antibacterials, anticoccidials, nutritional specialty products and vaccines for livestock producers, veterinarians and feed manufacturers raising food animals.
segments.evidence: Our Animal Health business develops, manufactures and markets about 345 product lines, including:

segments.name: Mineral Nutrition
segments.description: Supplies mineral nutrition products that fortify the animal's diet and help maintain optimal health for livestock producers and feed manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Mineral nutrition products that fortify the animal's diet and help maintain optimal health.

segments.description: Manufactures and markets specific ingredients for the personal care, industrial chemical and chemical catalyst industries, selling directly to customers in those industries.
segments.evidence: We sell performance products directly to customers in the aforementioned industries.

revenueModel.text: Livestock producers, feed manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors and veterinarians pay for animal health and mineral nutrition products.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell animal health and mineral nutrition products either directly to integrated poultry, cattle and swine producers or through animal feed manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors and veterinarians.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company completed the acquisition of Zoetis's medicated feed additive portfolio, reported within the Animal Health segment.
changes.evidence: On October 31, 2024, the Company completed the Acquisition at a purchase price of approximately $297.5 million ($286.5 million, as adjusted, net of cash acquired), subject to certain further adjustments set forth in the Purchase Agreement.
